description:
About this space
Enjoy a stylish stay in the heart of Bulawayo! This 2-bedroom apartment (sleeps 5) features 2 queen beds, a sofa bed, and a modern bathroom. Cook using a gas cooker, relax with hot water, and stay powered with backup solar. Unlimited, ultra-fast STARLINK WiFi — perfect for work, streaming, or gaming. FREE NETFLIX. Just a 5-min walk to Queen’s Sports Club, town centre and entertainment areas.

UNFORTUNATELY, THERE IS NO SECURE PARKING ONSITE. THERE IS SECURE GUARDED PAID PARKING ($2/night) NEARBY

The space
A centrally located Apartment ideal for business, leisure, and family stays.

2 double bedrooms, combined living/dining room.

This Apartment is conveniently located in the CBD, walking distance to Food Outlets, Grocery Shops, Banks, City Pool, Hospitals, Pharmacies, Leisure and Entertainment venues.

WiFi and Security

Reliable water and Electricity supply

The space
The Apartment is located in a quiet and safe part of Bulawayo CBD. It has two large bedrooms. There is a large lounge/dining, a kitchen, a separate toilet and bathroom with a shower, with hot water. The Kitchen has a gas stove, microwave oven, and an electric kettle.

Guest access
Guests are to advise Thembie (our host) of their arrival time, and she will be waiting to welcome you at the apartment.

Guests can use all the public places of the flat

Other things to note
UNFORTUNATELY, THERE IS NO SECURE PARKING ONSITE.

There are several parking sites 5 minutes from the apartment, where guests can park for a fee. (USUALLY $2/NIGHT).

Our co-hosts will be happy to show you these.
